subject.title: Anthropic rejects when multiple tool_result are split across separate messages

question: Should this ClawHub issue be routed to the OpenClaw runtime/provider tracker, kept parked here, or closed only after a linked runtime fix is confirmed?
rationale: The report appears actionable, but the affected serializer is not present in ClawHub and repository cleanup policy does not allow closing this issue without a confirmed current-main implementation.

options.title: Route to runtime/provider tracker
options.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime area so the Anthropic transcript conversion can be fixed and tested in the owning codebase.

options.title: Keep parked in ClawHub
options.body: Leave this issue open here as a visible support/routing reminder, accepting that the fix cannot be implemented in this repository.

options.title: Close after linked runtime fix
options.body: Close this issue only after a specific OpenClaw runtime commit or issue demonstrates that the reported tool-result ordering failure is fixed.

recommendation.title: Route to runtime/provider tracker
recommendation.body: Move or cross-link the report to the OpenClaw runtime area so the Anthropic transcript conversion can be fixed and tested in the owning codebase.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen is the strongest local routing candidate from the ClawHub catalog and OpenClaw provider-direction history inspected here.
